create.name: Vedanta Center of St. Petersburg
create.bio:
The Vedanta Center of St. Petersburg is a branch of the Ramakrishna Order on the south side of St. Petersburg, Florida, close to Tampa Bay. Its roots go back to 1951, when Malcolm and Earnly Panton, students of Swami Nikhilananda in New York, came to lead a local congregation; they moved it to the present site in 1958 and opened a new temple there the following year. After their deaths the members sought formal ties with the Order, and the centre became an official branch in the mid-2000s. Swami Ishtananda, a monk of the Order since the 1970s who earlier served in San Diego, has been its resident minister since late 2007.

Teaching rests on Vedanta as lived and taught by Sri Ramakrishna, Sri Sarada Devi and Swami Vivekananda, with an emphasis on the harmony of religions. The centre is open four days a week: a Sunday morning service with a talk, a Monday evening chanting class in the neighbouring Mother's House, and a Wednesday class on the Gita and on the recorded sayings of Ramakrishna, with Sunday and Wednesday sessions also on Zoom. Classes pause in July and August, when members join a week-long summer retreat. Recorded talks and classes are posted on its site, and it keeps a small bookshop and library.

free_resources.title: Sunday Lectures and Other Videos
free_resources.description: Recordings of recent Sunday talks at the centre, mostly by Swami Ishtananda with some visiting monks, embedded on one page and refreshed from time to time.

free_resources.title: Weekly Services and Classes
free_resources.description: The month's programme: Sunday service and talk, Monday evening chanting, and the Wednesday scripture class, with Sunday and Wednesday also offered on Zoom. Everyone is welcome and no fee is listed.

free_resources.title: Bhagavad Gita Class Videos
free_resources.description: Zoom recordings of the Wednesday evening Gita class, which reads the text with Sridhara Swami's commentary in Swami Vireswarananda's translation.

free_resources.title: Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna Class Videos
free_resources.description: Monthly class recordings working through the Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna, recorded on Zoom.

free_resources.title: Summer Retreat Videos
free_resources.description: Evening discourses from the centre's week-long summer retreat in July 2026, given by Swami Ishtananda and visiting monks of the Order.
